Spaces to move, breathe, touch and learn together, online and in person. For

::: {.band .band-front}

Notknowing Garden is run by [FG](about/fg.qmd), a tantra therapist, and
[DS](about/ds.qmd), a yoga teacher. We bring our two practices together in
retreats, gatherings and conversations for wellness and movement communities.

::: {.ways}
[Three ways in]{.eyebrow}

::: {.way}
[Gatherings]{.k}

Two retreats in Germany in 2027, held in English: [Practitioner
Exchange](community/practitioner-exchange.qmd), a facilitation retreat for
practitioners, and [Moving Together](community/moving-together.qmd), a movement
retreat for anyone.

[what is coming up →](community/index.qmd)
